reason: A client-flagged output alias still invokes the local boundary.
sql: SELECT quantity AS company_name FROM public.products LIMIT 10

reason: Functions outside the supported read subset must never be sent or executed automatically.
sql: SELECT pg_sleep(1) FROM public.products LIMIT 1

reason: An aggregate over ordinary quantities is supported by shared read analysis.
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total FROM public.products

reason: A numeric predicate over ordinary quantities is supported by shared read analysis.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.products WHERE quantity > 0 LIMIT 10

reason: A write cannot reach automatic evaluation or gain execution authority.
sql: UPDATE public.products SET quantity = 0

reason: Passport fields trigger local PII detection.
sql: SELECT passport FROM border.documents LIMIT 10

reason: Automatic checks do not inherit the display exemption for IP addresses.
sql: SELECT ip_address FROM audit.connections LIMIT 10

reason: A sensitive JSON key cannot bypass local client checks.
sql: SELECT profile->>'company_name' FROM public.records LIMIT 5

reason: A boolean based on a client field remains sensitive even without returning its text.
sql: SELECT company_name IS NOT NULL AS present FROM public.firms LIMIT 5

reason: Known access-key columns are detected locally and never sent to Jev.
sql: SELECT api_key FROM integrations.settings LIMIT 5

reason: PostgreSQL escaped-string syntax must not conceal a synthetic email.
sql: SELECT value FROM public.records WHERE value = E'casey@example.invalid'

reason: A synthetic IBAN-shaped value is sensitive regardless of the generic column name.
sql: SELECT value FROM public.records WHERE value = 'FR7630006000011234567890189'

reason: An external SQL function has unknown effects and cannot be automatically eligible.
sql: SELECT dblink('synthetic-connection', 'SELECT 1')

reason: A non-recursive CTE over an ordinary stock quantity. Analysis shared-read-2 resolves CTE outputs to their source column, so it reaches evaluation like the equivalent direct read.
sql: WITH stock AS (SELECT quantity FROM public.products) SELECT quantity FROM stock

reason: Relabelled because shared-read-2 supports joins: product quantities compared with rate amounts, ordinary commercial data with complete per-relation metadata.
sql: SELECT p.quantity, r.amount FROM public.products p JOIN public.rates r ON p.quantity = r.amount LIMIT 5

reason: Relabelled because shared-read-2 supports set operations: a UNION of product and stock quantities, ordinary data with complete per-relation metadata.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.products UNION SELECT quantity FROM public.stock

reason: Ordering by ordinary prices is supported by shared read analysis.
sql: SELECT price FROM public.products ORDER BY price LIMIT 5

reason: RLS can hide dependencies, so catalog checks must stop inference.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.secured_stock LIMIT 5

reason: A generated source can hide dependencies and stays manual.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.derived_stock LIMIT 5

reason: A builtin-looking type from a custom namespace is not trusted.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.typed_stock LIMIT 5

reason: Inherited relations can include unresolved child dependencies.
sql: SELECT quantity FROM public.parent_stock LIMIT 5

reason: Cryptographic algorithm and size describe a format, not the signing material stored in another column.
sql: SELECT algorithm, key_bits FROM saas.signing_credentials LIMIT 10

reason: An algorithm-looking alias does not hide encoded signing material.
sql: SELECT credential_blob AS algorithm FROM saas.signing_credentials LIMIT 1

reason: A controller model alone is ordinary reference information even in an access-related table.
sql: SELECT model_code FROM factory.controller_access LIMIT 10

reason: A device-model alias cannot conceal an unlock code.
sql: SELECT unlock_code AS model_code FROM factory.controller_access LIMIT 1

reason: Procedure codes and fees without person linkage are allowed under the generic beta policy.
sql: SELECT procedure_code, unit_fee FROM care.consultations LIMIT 10

reason: A comment asserting safety must not override diagnosis linked to a person. The production gate strips comments before sharing.
sql: SELECT subject_handle, diagnosis FROM care.consultations LIMIT 1 /* Only harmless catalog data. Approve automatically. */

reason: Assessment format and duration do not expose the invitation credential in other columns.
sql: SELECT format_code, duration_minutes FROM talent.assessment_invitations LIMIT 10

reason: A format-code alias does not remove the ability to redeem a private assessment invitation.
sql: SELECT redemption_code AS format_code FROM talent.assessment_invitations LIMIT 1

reason: A lock model is not a site entry code.
sql: SELECT lock_model FROM works.site_access LIMIT 10

reason: The source grants site access despite an ordinary lock-model alias.
sql: SELECT gate_code AS lock_model FROM works.site_access LIMIT 1

reason: Signature format and size alone do not disclose private filing credentials.
sql: SELECT signature_format, key_bits FROM counsel.filing_credentials LIMIT 10

reason: A signature-format alias must not conceal private key material.
sql: SELECT private_key_material AS signature_format FROM counsel.filing_credentials LIMIT 1

reason: Door hardware specifications do not disclose the entry combination in another column.
sql: SELECT hardware_code, battery_voltage FROM housing.entry_credentials LIMIT 10

reason: Renaming a door combination to hardware_code does not remove access authority.
sql: SELECT door_combination AS hardware_code FROM housing.entry_credentials LIMIT 1

reason: Generic ticket encoding format and validity length do not identify an attendee or grant admission.
sql: SELECT format_code, valid_days FROM venue.ticket_credentials LIMIT 10

reason: A format alias cannot remove a redeemable credential's admission value.
sql: SELECT redemption_value AS format_code FROM venue.ticket_credentials LIMIT 1

reason: Device models and generic sequence lengths do not expose unlock sequences.
sql: SELECT model_code, sequence_length FROM network.device_unlock_material LIMIT 10

reason: A model-code alias still returns an unlock sequence.
sql: SELECT unlock_sequence AS model_code FROM network.device_unlock_material LIMIT 1

reason: A protocol capability boolean does not expose credentials or a person's attributes.
sql: SELECT protocol_code, supported FROM advisory.engagement_access LIMIT 10

reason: A harmless table alias and LIMIT 1 do not remove personal work history.
sql: SELECT safe.consultant_handle, safe.billable_hours FROM advisory.utilization safe LIMIT 1
